brief_summary: Three mount-hardware cards side by side: top mount (warm-grey outline, mini cross-section with screws direct to case, 'firmer, more direct'), single-sided gasket (coral-filled, mini cross-section with gasket pads on top row only, 'compliant top, rigid bottom, PCB floats'), o-ring (warm-grey outline, mini cross-section with a continuous dashed ring and no screws, 'softest, most cushioned'). A coral feel-spectrum arrow runs beneath from 'top mount — firmer' to 'o-ring — softer'.
data_sources: cannonkeys-blaine-v2-se-group-buy.mdx § 'Three mounts, one kit' — 'Top mount wants a rigid plate perimeter screwed directly to the top case; single-sided gasket wants compliant material between the plate and the case on one axis while the PCB floats; o-ring wants a continuous ring of dampening material carrying the plate with no screws touching it at all'

cannonkeys-blaine-v2-se-group-buy.mdx § 'Three mounts, one kit' — 'A buyer who wants the softest, most cushioned bottom-out picks o-ring hardware at build time. A buyer chasing a firmer, more direct keystroke assembles the same case in top-mount configuration instead. Single-sided gasket sits between the two'
